key_terms.الْحُسْنَىٰ: The Good (often referring to Paradise or the ultimate reward)

ai.seo_question: What does 'Al-Husna' refer to in the context of the Night Quran verse?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, 'Al-Husna' is often interpreted not merely as Paradise but as the highest degree of divine proximity and the ultimate success of the faithful, particularly linked to the Ahl al-Bayt. This affirmation underscores the believer's conviction in the reality of the Hereafter and the justice of God, serving as a spiritual anchor for endurance in trials.
